"""Console-only log line formatter: prints `[level] message` to stdout."""

import builtins
import os
from typing import NoReturn

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print `[level] message` to standard output.

    Writes only to stdout. Never opens or writes any file.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_format(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "service started")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] service started\n"


def test_log_line_level_is_bracketed_verbatim(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("warn", "disk at 91%")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[warn] disk at 91%\n"


def test_log_line_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("DEBUG", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[DEBUG] \n"


def test_log_line_writes_only_to_stdout(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "boom")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[ERROR] boom\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_log_line_does_not_touch_filesystem(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    def forbidden(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> NoReturn:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not access the file system")

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "open", forbidden)
    log_line("INFO", "no files")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] no files\n"
